posts.name: 34-ai-chatbots-see-letters
posts.caption:
Most AI chatbots never see individual letters, which is why they stumble when asked to spell a word backwards 🔤

Researchers rewired Llama 3, Qwen3 and Olmo 3 to read raw bytes using under 1% of normal training. Letter tasks jumped (Olmo: 54.3 to 78.1) while general scores stayed about the same. Caveat: only models up to about 8 billion parameters were tested, and first try coding got slightly worse.

Source: Minixhofer, Hofmann et al. (Allen Institute for AI, University of Cambridge, University of Washington), “Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes”, Nature, 2026.
